card.name: Words before human health effects
card.fires_on: The word 'human' (and similar words like 'no', 'minimize', 'adverse', 'affecting') in environmental or safety text, right before a word like health, exposure or threat.

modes.label: Human before health
modes.description: The word 'human' just before health or exposure in environmental and toxicity text.

modes.label: Harm-related lead-in words
modes.description: Words such as no, minimize, adverse or affecting that come before a mention of harm or effects.

card.writes: It pushes the model to continue with words about human health or the body, in English and Chinese.
card.plain: It fires on words that set up a phrase about effects on human health or the body.
